institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Limited shelf life and loss of freshness of unripe matured and tender jackfruit.
description: A process for the production of ready-to-cook dehydrated unripe and tender jackfruit. The process utilizes a drier, slicer, and steamer, allowing the product to be vacuum packaged in flexible polyethylene bags without added preservatives.
applications: • Manufacturing of ready-to-cook packaged fruit products • Processing of dehydrated base ingredients for commercial curries • Production of preservative-free shelf-stable tropical fruits • Deployment in post-harvest agricultural value-addition facilities
